title: Text colour forwarding
summary: The thiscall method first invokes the base item colour setter and forwards the same pointer to the associated visual unless the kind at offset 0x10 is 3.
test_description: Compare original and recovered calls with an empty base item entry range, kind 3 including null visual, other kinds, equal and changed colours, NaN, signed zero and infinity. Compare object and visual bytes, input preservation, flags and FS head; the base and visual methods use accepted references as test adapters.
known_limits: The base and visual methods are external dependencies; their production implementations must be supplied separately.
Nonempty base entry ranges and overlapping input storage are not exercised. Object field identities beyond observed offsets remain unresolved.
Null pointers on paths that dereference them and exceptional floating-point behavior are not tested.
